common.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

leases.title: Lease agreements
leases.subtitle: Who rents, since when, how much they pay and on what day. This is where the month's charges come from.

kpi.balanceHint: Everything still owed across all leases.
kpi.overdueHint: With a balance and past the payment date.

empty.title: No leases yet
empty.body: Create the first one: pick the property, add the tenant and the rent, and the system builds every monthly charge for you.

emptyFiltered.title: No leases match those filters
emptyFiltered.body: Try another status or clear the search.

form.propertyHint: The property being rented. If it is missing, add it under Properties first.
form.tenantHint: The person who signs and pays.
form.guarantorHint: Optional. Whoever answers if the tenant stops paying.
form.paymentDayHint: The day of the month it is due. If the month is shorter, it falls on the last day.
form.depositHint: Recorded as held when the lease is activated.
form.notesHint: Whatever was agreed and does not fit in a field. Only your team sees it.
form.preview: {count} charges will be created, one per month.
form.previewNone: Those dates produce no charges. Check the start and end.

actions.activateHint: Activating creates every charge for the term and records the deposit.
actions.terminateConfirm: The lease will be ended. Charges and payments stay as history. Continue?
actions.regenerateHint: Nothing is duplicated: it only adds months that do not exist yet.
actions.deleteConfirm: This lease is a draft with no money recorded. Delete it?

toast.activated: Lease is active. {count} charges were created.

detail.noParties: Nobody has been added yet. Without a tenant the lease cannot be activated.
detail.noCharges: No charges yet. They are created when the lease is activated.
detail.noPayments: No payment has been received yet.

expiring.title: Expiring soon
expiring.body: Renew in time: a lease that lapses unnoticed leaves the property earning nothing.
expiring.none: No lease expires in the next 90 days.

collections.title: Collections
collections.subtitle: What is due this month, what has been paid and what is overdue. All on one page.

kpi.chargedHint: The sum of every charge in the period.
kpi.collectedHint: What came in, partial payments included.
kpi.balanceHint: The month's balance, overdue or not.
kpi.overdueHint: With a balance and past the payment date.

empty.title: Nothing to collect this month
empty.body: Once you activate a lease its charges show up here, one per month.

emptyFiltered.title: Nothing in that aging bucket
emptyFiltered.body: Tap “Show the whole month” to go back.

collections.sweepHint: Creates missing charges, flags what is overdue and builds today's reminders.

payment.title: Record a payment
payment.amountHint: It can be less than the charge: it stays as a partial payment with its balance.
payment.referenceHint: The wire reference or transfer number, if there is one.
payment.deleteConfirm: The payment will be removed and the charge goes back to owing. Continue?

receipt.label: Receipt
receipt.notInvoice: It is a rent receipt, not a tax document.

reminders.title: Payment reminders
reminders.subtitle: Four touches per charge, each with a different tone. One message repeated four times becomes noise and people mute it.
reminders.planWhatsapp: Your plan includes WhatsApp: reminders go out over WhatsApp and stay pending in the panel.
reminders.planNoWhatsapp: Your plan is Propietario and does NOT include WhatsApp. Reminders go out by EMAIL and stay pending here in the panel.
reminders.planUpgrade: To send them over WhatsApp you need to move up to the Asesor plan.

help.PREVIO_5: A friendly heads-up that the payment day is near.
help.DIA_PAGO: The day-of reminder, with the amount and how to pay.
help.VENCIDO_3: It is overdue: the balance is stated and a date is requested.

reminders.queueBody: A reminder only goes out on the exact day of its step, so an old charge never sends a daily message forever.
reminders.noEmail: No email on file: this reminder only stays pending here.
reminders.cron: The daily sweep builds them on its own. You can also run it by hand from above.

increase.title: Annual rent increase
increase.subtitle: Compute the increase from inflation, check the cap and generate the notice for the tenant.
increase.inpcMissing: Inflation has not been captured yet
increase.inpcMissingBody: The INPC lives in the calculator parameters and has not been loaded. Enter the percentage by hand and carry on: nothing is blocked.
increase.pctMissing: This lease has no agreed percentage
increase.pctMissingBody: Its increase rule is a fixed percentage, but it is empty. Enter it here or edit it in the lease details.
increase.noneRule: This lease was agreed with NO increase. If you still want to raise the rent, enter the percentage.
increase.capLaw: In Mexico City the annual increase cannot exceed the previous year's inflation (Civil Code reform, August 2024).
increase.capNotApplies: This property is not in Mexico City, so that cap does not apply to it.
increase.locked: {count} charges are left alone because they already have payments.
increase.overTitle: That increase exceeds the Mexico City cap
increase.overBody: The cap is {cap} and you are entering {pct}. Saving it this way can leave the clause unenforceable if the tenant challenges it.
increase.overReasonHint: It is recorded in the lease with your name and the date.
increase.overConfirm: I understand and I am applying it anyway
increase.noticeBody: Copy it and send it. An increase is announced in writing and in advance.

deposit.title: Security deposit
deposit.subtitle: It is the tenant's money. It is held for the term and at the end it is returned or applied, always with a note.
deposit.noteHint: Write down why it is returned or applied. Without a note that decision cannot be defended later.
deposit.empty: No deposit recorded on this lease.
deposit.compareHint: Before resolving it, compare the move-in inventory against the move-out one.

inventory.title: Property inventory
inventory.subtitle: Room by room, with dated photos and both signatures. It is the only proof that settles the deposit argument at the end.
inventory.signedByHint: The names of whoever hands over and whoever receives.
inventory.addRoomHint: It drops in the usual items and you only correct what changed.
inventory.compareBody: Side by side, with the photos from both times. Whatever got worse is flagged.

verdict.SOLO_ENTRADA: Not checked on the way out
verdict.SOLO_SALIDA: Was not in the move-in list

summary.missing: {count} were not checked on the way out

empty.title: No walkthroughs yet
empty.body: Record the move-in inventory the day you hand over the house. Without it there is nothing to compare against at the end.

inventory.onlyEntrada: The move-out inventory is missing. Record it the day you take the house back.
inventory.onlySalida: There is no move-in inventory, so there is nothing to compare against.
inventory.photoHint: Photos are compressed before uploading and count against your plan's storage.
inventory.storageFull: Your plan is out of storage. Delete photos you no longer need or move up a plan.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.subtitle: What the tenant reports, who fixed it and what it cost. The cost flows into the property's expenses.
maintenance.descriptionHint: In detail: where, since when and what has been tried.
maintenance.reportedByHint: Almost always the tenant, who has no panel account.
maintenance.createExpense: Record the cost as a property expense
maintenance.createExpenseHint: That way the property's return does not depend on someone remembering to enter it separately.

empty.title: No open issues
empty.body: When the tenant reports something it shows up here with their photos.

maintenance.noExpensePermission: The cost was saved, but you do not have permission to record property expenses.
maintenance.portalNote: Tenants will also be able to report from their portal once it is ready.

expenses.title: Property expenses
expenses.subtitle: Property tax, water, maintenance and repairs. This is what later makes each property's return real.
expenses.receiptUrlHint: Optional. The proof you keep yourself; this product does not issue tax documents.

empty.title: No expenses recorded yet
empty.body: Enter the property tax, the water and the repairs. Without them, the property's return is gross rent dressed up as profit.

statement.title: Statement of account
statement.notInvoice: This document is a lease statement of account, not a tax document.
